evidence.quote: The degree programme is taught entirely in English.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: all countries 8,200 EUR

notes: Tuition 8,200 EUR is per semester for applicants from all countries; the DAAD page does not convert it to a yearly figure. No specific application deadline day and month is given ("the end of June"), so the intake deadline is null. No document list is quoted on the DAAD programme page, so "documents" is omitted; the Frankfurt School AIDE pages are for a different programme and were not used. The application channel is the university's own portal ("Please check this website"), not uni-assist.
